# Nakul Properties - Faridabad Real Estate Advisory

Nakul Properties is a premium and trusted real estate consultancy based in Faridabad, Haryana, India. Specializing in HUDA/HSVP sector plots, luxury independent builder floors, commercial SCO plots, and gated townships across Faridabad and Greater Faridabad.

## Contact Information
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 98115 48267
- **Address:** Sector 65, Faridabad, Haryana - 121004
- **Primary Website:** https://nakulproperties.com

## Key Offerings & Services
- **HUDA / HSVP Sector Plots:** Freehold plots with 100% clear legal titles in Sector 14, 15, 21, and other prime sectors.
- **Independent Builder Floors:** Luxury 3 BHK and 4 BHK floors with private lifts, stilt parking, and exclusive terrace rights.
- **Gated Township Plots:** Residential plots in secured gated societies like BPTP Parklands, Puri Amanvilas, Omaxe, and RPS Savana.
- **Commercial Shops & SCO:** Retail shops and commercial land leasing (B+G+3 permitted layouts) on main Mathura Road highway and Omaxe World Street.
